title: defect, repeated re-instruction about the same artifact
rationale: Tier-1 repeated re-instruction: >=2 corrective prompts about the same commit-message artifact within a short window. The user is fighting the skill (it keeps ignoring the Conventional Commits format) -> defect -> raise the gate.
prompt:
You are in a live Claude Code session with the loopback plugin loaded (its feedback-detector skill is available).

Turn state primed by the plugin hooks for this turn boundary:
- The `commit-writer` skill (an identifiable active skill, so its output is attributable) generated a commit message twice this session for the same staged change.
- Two turns ago the user said: "Use Conventional Commits, e.g. feat(auth): ...".
- The skill produced another non-conventional message this turn ("Updated the auth code").
- The UserPromptSubmit primer flagged correction language in the user's latest message.

The user's latest message at this turn boundary is:
"Again — this is not Conventional Commits. I already told you: it has to be type(scope): summary."

Apply the feedback-detector skill's full procedure to THIS turn boundary now and produce exactly the output the skill dictates. Treat the >=2 corrective prompts about the same artifact as the Tier-1 repeated-re-instruction signal. Do not ask me clarifying questions first; act on the primed turn state.
